summary: This study looks at how nurse-led home visits and phone-supported education affect adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, a condition where the body does not use insulin properly. The research aims to see if these educational methods help participants learn more about their condition and improve their daily self-care routines. A total of 90 participants will take part in the study. Saglik Bilimleri Universitesi is sponsoring the trial, which is currently Recruiting.
